description: Run the quantakrypto detectors over a code snippet (NOT the filesystem) and report any classical crypto that remains. Use this to confirm an edit actually removed the quantum-vulnerable usage. Provide 'code' plus a 'language' or 'filename'.

filename.description: Optional filename; its extension selects the detectors (overrides 'language').

language.description: Language of the code (js, ts, python, go, java, csharp, rust, ruby, c, …).

name: verify_fix
